explanation.headline: Water is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 2.4 days on hand and the rule recommends buying from American Regent, Inc. (VAI 2024-04-24)

sentences.text: FDA's records show water is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 8 vials of water 1 mL/mL, 10 mL at 3.4 a day, giving 2.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 46 vials at 4.3 a day, giving 10.6 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 7 vials at 0.7 a day, giving 9.7 days on hand.
The rule's best option is to buy from American Regent, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant last inspection was VAI 2024-04-24.
Alternate manufacturers include B. Braun Medical Inc. and Civica, Inc. (Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., last inspection NAI 2026-05-13), both also not on FDA's shortage list.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
